name: Soccer pitch
headline: length
subtitle: International match size under IFAB Law 1 (The Field of Play)
description: Soccer pitches do not have one fixed size. The Laws of the Game allow touchlines from 90 to 120 m in general, but international matches must be played on a pitch 100 to 110 m long and 64 to 75 m wide. The goals are 7.32 m (8 yd) wide between the posts and 2.44 m (8 ft) high to the underside of the crossbar. The penalty mark is 11 m from the goal.

facts.text: The penalty area reaches 16.5 m (18 yd) out from the inside of each goalpost and 16.5 m into the field; the goal area is 5.5 m (6 yd) on the same pattern.
Goalposts and the crossbar may be no more than 12 cm (5 in) wide, and all pitch lines share one width of no more than 12 cm.
Competitions may choose their own touchline and goal line lengths as long as they stay within the Law 1 limits.

sources.title: Laws of the Game, Law 1 - The Field of Play (latest edition)

caveats: There is no single pitch size; the headline range is the one allowed for international matches.
The IFAB gives metric and imperial figures side by side; they are rounded equivalents, not exact conversions (for example 100 m is listed with 110 yd).
